transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I don't know, really. I guess... I just barely want to eat anymore. Like, I'll be on my lunch break at the store, just staring at food I used to like... and I just throw most of it away. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
I don't know... maybe a little. I just... I don't really feel much of anything. Just kind of empty, I guess.
Have you lost weight recently?
Yeah... probably. I mean, like I was saying, I just don't really eat my lunches anymore. I just toss 'em out. So... I guess I've dropped a few pounds.
Do you still enjoy activities that you used to like?

Um... I guess not. I used to do stuff. Like, play basketball... go to gallery nights, grab tacos from those food trucks. Or help kids out with art stuff. But lately... I don't know. I just kind of stand there feeling flat. I usually just make an excuse to take off.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight, like more than 5% of your body weight, in the past month?

I don't really know about percentages or... numbers. I don't weigh myself. But like I was saying... I just barely want to eat anymore. 

I guess that's kind of what made me finally ask for help. I'll just be on my lunch break at the store... staring at food I used to actually like. And I just end up throwing most of it away. So... yeah. Probably.
How long have you been feeling this way about the things you used to enjoy?
Um... about two months, I think. It started around the time I won this... window display award at work. The district manager made a big deal out of it, and... yeah. Since then, mostly.
Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself?
Um... no. I haven't. I don't really think about doing anything like that.
Do you have difficulty sleeping at night?

Yeah... I guess so. Most nights I just... I lie there. Kind of replaying that award thing in my head, or... conversations from the store. And then... if I actually do manage to fall asleep, I just wake up way too early anyway. I just can't get my mind to shut back off.
Do you find yourself moving more slowly than usual or feeling like you're speeding up in your thoughts or actions?
I don't know. I guess I'm just... normal? I haven't really noticed anything like that. Just... tired, mostly.
Do you feel like you're a burden to the people around you?

I don't know about a burden, really. Just... guilty, I guess. Like... I keep thinking I don't deserve that award I got. Or the chance at being supervisor. It just feels like I... like I tricked everybody into giving it to me. People keep telling me I didn't, but... yeah. I just feel bad about it.
Do you often feel worthless?

I mean... kind of like what I just said. I just don't think I deserve it. The award, or... the supervisor thing. It just feels like a mistake, I guess. Like I tricked them into thinking I'm better than I am.
Have you had any days in the past two months where you felt somewhat better, or has it been consistently this way?

I don't think so. It's just... been like this. For about two months, I guess. Ever since that... that window display award. And the district manager coming around. Just... consistently like this since then.
Have you had any significant changes in your interest in social activities or being around other people over the past two months?

I don't really go out much anymore. I used to... I don't know, like going to gallery nights or playing basketball. Sometimes getting tacos from the food trucks or helping out with the kids' art programs. But lately... I just don't feel anything when I do those things. I just kind of stand there. Usually, I just make up an excuse so I can leave early.
Do you feel like your lack of interest in things and feeling empty are interfering with your ability to function at work or take care of yourself?

I guess... yeah, it is. I'm still showing up for my shifts, but... I've been messing up the inventory counts. And the display plans. My manager has to keep double-checking everything I do now. And... like I said, I just don't go to the gallery nights or basketball anymore. I haven't been to the youth art workshops either. I just... can't.
Have you been feeling sad most of the day, nearly every day, over the past two months?
I don't know about sad. I don't really... I'm not crying all the time or anything. Just mostly... like I said before, just empty, I guess. I wouldn't call it sad.
Would you say you've been feeling depressed most of the day, nearly every day, over the past two months?
I guess... yeah. Just... empty. Like I said. Most days, yeah.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy or find pleasure in?

Not really. I used to like... going to those gallery nights, or playing basketball. Getting tacos from the food trucks. Helping out with the youth art stuff. But now... I don't know. If I do go, I just kind of stand there. It all just feels flat. I usually just make an excuse to leave early.
Are there any small things that still give you pleasure, like a favorite food or activity?
I mean... like I just said. No. Not even the food trucks or the art stuff. None of it. Like I told you, I just feel flat and end up leaving.
Would you say your feelings of emptiness are mild, moderate, or severe?
I don't know... mild, I guess. Just... there.
Would you say your feelings of emptiness have been getting worse over the past two months?
I'm not sure. I haven't really thought about it. Just... feels the same, I guess.
